release_note: Wave 5 carrier architecture: source-pinned read-only semantic navigation is exposed through GET /gaiaos/context and MCP gaia_context using Gaia-native DictionaryOS term/alias resolution plus explicit YggdrasilOS graph traversal. The stable carrier is extended by api/gaiaos_app.py and boots as carrier 1.5.0. Local navigation previously passed run 68 and proof-bearing pointers passed run 71. Current-wave carrier CI and deployment remain separately unproven until observed. The current six operator slots remain placeholders until Naomi adopts or changes them; donor architecture does not transfer Raven identity, ownership, continuity, or voice.
